name: Kokonoe Yukari
source:
Hobbies: Educational programs
Skills: Making sweets, sleeping in trains
Favorite Food: Sweets
Weakness: Crows, bats, black plastic bags

A naturally airheaded and spoiled girl who helps around a coffee shop her parents own. She likes watching TV, especially educational programs. Yukari is also a master at making sweets, and loves them; many people consider her to be a great, dream wife in the future.
